card.name: Restrictive adverbs ending a clause
card.fires_on: The adverbs "only" or "promptly" placed right after a verb or noun phrase, most often in "for educational purposes only", "administered only", and "oral ingestion only".

modes.label: Use-limiting "only"
modes.description: "Only" closes a phrase that restricts how something is used or given, as in disclaimers and route statements.
